title: Explorer unit classification
responsibility: Assigns units to readable explorer categories and role names.

inputs.name: explorerCategory.unit
inputs.description: A Classified view of a unit: kind, owned source and symbol lists, and optional helper, catalog, and model-definition metadata. Category overrides read owned source paths and these optional fields; owned symbols themselves are not inspected.

inputs.name: explorerRole.unit
inputs.description: A Classified view of a unit: kind, owned source and symbol lists, and optional helper, catalog, and model-definition metadata. Role overrides inspect the kind, owned source paths, and model declarations; helper and catalog metadata do not affect the returned role.

outputs.name: explorerCategory
outputs.description: Returns one explorer category or null. Internal units and nonvisual layouts are excluded first; otherwise the implementation checks compatibility route paths, rendered addresses, layout configuration modules, owned model declarations, and mapped kind, with function/module categories requiring a helper accepted by helperContract.

outputs.name: explorerRole
outputs.description: Returns a reader-facing role label. It prioritizes type definitions, route configuration, route aliases, rendered pages, and route-loader kinds, then uses a known kind mapping or capitalized words from the kind.
